name: 2025-2c-parcial1
title: Marine ROV specimen capture
description: Simulate a marine ROV capturing specimens on a 2D map: two arms (vacuum, net) whose grab area depends on the environment (muddy, rocky), two specimen kinds with escape moves, and a contingency mode once the net breaks. The student must design the model from scratch so that 16 given tests pass, implementing the stubbed test helpers.

design.notes: Behaviour is a three-way combination of arm x environment x specimen kind (area shape, escape move, breakage) plus a normal/contingency ROV state, which invites polymorphic dispatch across several small hierarchies instead of nested ifs; the tests fix only the helper protocol, leaving the model's abstractions open.
